√śaś 'leap'
present: [1.] śaśati etc. 
[perfect: śaśāśa śaśaśus aśaśīt śaśiṣyati śaśitā ]
verbal: śaśita 
derivatives: śaśá V.+ 
Doubtless a denominative formation from śaśá. Only two or three occurrences.

√śas 'cut'
present: [2.] śasta (2p.) śāsti śā́sati śā́satu (3p.) aśāt (3s.) -- [1.] śasatha śásanti aśasat 
perfect: śaśāsa śaśasus 
future: [1.] śasiṣyati -- [2.] śasitā 
verbal: śasta -śasya -śásas 
secondary: passive: śasyáte etc. B.+ -- desiderative: śiśāsiṣant 
derivatives: -śas śāsá AV.B.S. śásana V.+ śasitṛ B.+ śástṛ V.+ śastrá B.+ -śāstṛ B.S. -śiśāsiṣu B.

√śās1 'order'
present: [2.] śā́sti śā́sati etc. śāstána śiṣyāt etc. aśāt B.+ śā́ste śāsīta śā́sāna etc. V.+ -- [1.] śāsati etc. E.+ śāsate 
perfect: śaśāsa śaśāsus etc. V.+ śaśādhi śaśās 
aorist: [2.] aśiṣat etc. śiṣánt śiṣāmahi śiṣāmahe -- [3.] aśaśāsat 
future: [1.] śāsiṣyati śāsiṣyate etc. B.+ -- [2.] śāsitā 
verbal: śiṣṭá V.+ śāsta S.+ śāsita E.+ śāstum S.+ śāsitum E.+ śiṣṭvā śāsitvā -śiṣya -śāsya E.+ 
secondary: passive: śāsyate etc. E.+ śiṣyate etc. -- intensive: śāśās- śeśiṣ- -- desiderative: śiśāsiṣa- -- causative: śāsaya- 
derivatives: śā́s -śiṣ V.+ śāsá V. śāsā́ RV. śā́sa RV. -śāsaka C. śāsin C. śā́sya V.+ śiṣya B.+ śā́sana V.+ śāsanīya C. śā́sus RV. śāsti C. -śiṣṭi V.B.S. śāsitṛ E.+ śāstṛ́ V.+ śāstrá V.+ 
Compare the apprently related root śaṅs.

√sas 'sleep'
present: [2.] sásti etc. sastás sasánt etc. -- [3.] sasásti sásasti sasat 
[perfect: sasāsa asīṣasat asasīt asāsīt sasiṣyati sasitā sāsas- sisasiṣa- sāsaya- ]
derivatives: sasá? 
The single later occurence is doubtless artificial.
